== Biography ==
Samuel was born in 1830 in Adams County, Ohio, and passed away in 1906 in Seattle, Washington.

In 1860, 1870, and 1880, Samuel was in Jackson Township, Washington County, Iowa. he was listed as a farmer.

By the time of the 1900 census, Samuel was living at the corner of John and Broadway in Seattle. He was listed as a retired merchant.
